data.notes: October 2027 is still lightly announced, with only a handful of firm Los Angeles-area music dates currently verifiable from venue, organizer, or major ticketing sources.

events.title: Fontaines D.C. with Iceage
events.summary: Kia Forum lists Fontaines D.C. on October 15, 2027, with Iceage supporting. Ticketmaster confirms the Inglewood date at 8:00 PM and identifies the venue as Kia Forum.

events.title: NaijaFest LA 2027
events.summary: NaijaFest LA lists its next event for Saturday, October 2, 2027, from 12 PM to 7 PM at Gloria Molina Grand Park. The free Nigerian Independence Day celebration is billed around culture, community, food, DJs, and live music, with 2027 performers not yet announced.

events.title: Eros Ramazzotti — UNA HISTORIA IMPORTANTE
events.summary: AXS confirms Eros Ramazzotti at YouTube Theater in Inglewood on Saturday, October 16, 2027, at 8:00 PM. The event is listed as rescheduled from November 7, 2026.

events.title: Open Melody presents Golomb LA Debut and Amps for Christ
events.summary: Open Melody confirms an off-season Los Angeles show on Saturday, October 10, 2027, featuring Golomb’s LA debut and Amps for Christ at Oblivion. The listing gives the venue address, 7 PM doors, all-ages admission, and advance price.
